name: Form 4 History & Government: The Constitution of Kenya 2010
subject: History & Government
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to state the key features of the 2010 constitution
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to explain the importance of the bill of rights
learningActivities: Discussion: what do learners know about the constitution?
Explanation: teacher outlines the key features of the 2010 constitution
Group work: learners discuss the bill of rights
Application: learners relate constitutional rights to everyday life
keyPoints: The 2010 constitution was promulgated on 27 August 2010
It established a bill of rights and devolved government
It provides for the separation of powers among the three arms of government
commonMisconceptions: Confusing the 2010 constitution with the independence constitution
Thinking the constitution only affects politicians
lessonEvaluation: Learners state the key features of the 2010 constitution and explain the bill of rights.
teacherReflection: Good understanding. Relate to devolution next lesson.
